newsitem.title: UK: TrizecHahn forms partnership with Dieter Bock.
newsitem.headline: TrizecHahn forms partnership with Dieter Bock.

text.p: Canada's TrizecHahn Corporation said on Wednesday it had formed a strategic alliance with German businessman Dieter Bock to expand its European real estate presence. The Toronto-based group said in a statement it would acquire property projects in Britain and Germany from Bock's Advanta Management AG for approximately $147 million through the issuance of subordinate voting shares, the assumption of development liabilities and construction financing.
TrizecHahn said Bock would become president of TrizecHahn Europe and a director of the company, with an equity stake of approximately four percent.

It described the partnership as "an important strategic move", reflecting its commitment to expanding outside North America. It said Bock had announced he would resign as non-executive deputy chairman of Lonrho Plc and also as a director.

"The opportunity at TrizecHahn will demand my full attention," Bock said in the statement. Under the terms of the deal, which is expected to close in April, TrizecHahn's existing European operations will be merged with its new German and British development projects under Bock's leadership. TrizecHahn, one of North America's largest publicly traded real estate developers, owns, develops and manages office buildings and regional shopping centres in the U.S., Canada and Central Europe.
